batting.name: SE Marsh
batting.dismissal: c SM Pollock b SD Chitnis

batting.name: JR Hopes
batting.dismissal: c PR Shah b SM Pollock

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c DR Smith b SD Chitnis

batting.name: AM Nayar
batting.dismissal: c TM Srivastava b PP Chawla

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c JR Hopes b Yuvraj Singh

batting.name: SM Pollock
batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b Yuvraj Singh

batting.name: PR Shah
batting.dismissal: c VRV Singh b S Sreesanth

batting.name: A Nehra
batting.dismissal: run out (TM Srivastava, DPMD Jayawardene, U Kaul)

balls.text: take that! Nehra feeds it on his pads, that's suicidal as Pomersback stays at the crease and just clubs it over the bowler and beats long-on
finally Nehra has something to smile about, he bowls a slower one outside off, Pomersback shuffles walks his stumps and misses the paddle scoop
Pomersbach gets better and better, he seizes a good length delivery on middle and leg, gives scant respect to the bowler by getting on his knee and slog sweeping him over deep square leg
Nehra slides on the pads this time, he exposes all three stumps this time and whips it over square leg, the timing was excellent and there was no chance of any fielder stopping that
fires in a full delivery on middle and leg, he exposes his stumps and lofts over mid-on
much better, he fires this one full and flat on seeing Pomersbach make room and he pushes it down to extra cover
bad start, he fails to control the movement and slides this one wide down the legside
good finish to the over for Punjab, he steps down the track and punishes a flat delivery past the bowler and long-off
fires this one wide outside off, he reaches out and taps it towards mid-off
Irfan sees the flight outside the legstump, gives him the charge and tonks it high over long-on
well bowled, he walks across his stumps and nearly falls over after shuffling a bit too much
slides on the pads, he walks across and whips it towards short fine leg
almost a run-out! He taps it towards Chitnis at cover and sets off, Yeligati whips off the bails but Pommy's back home
cheeky! Fernando fires this one outside the offstump, he makes room and deftly glides it wide the keeper who dives in vain to his left
Pomersbach wins this battle as he whips an overpitched delivery on the pads and sends the ball screeching past deep square leg, he tries to stop it with his boot
Jayawardene gets foxed by the slower delivery as he tries to loft him downtown, he releases the handle as he makes contact with the ball and Fernando himself takes the skier
he finally manages to get some wood on it this time but it's a leading edge which falls safe from long-off
Pomersbach's struggle against Fernando continues, this time he fires in a quick bouncer which fizzes past his face
lands on a fullish length on middle and leg, he shuffles and whips it on the up and the ball goes to fine leg on the first bounce
fires it on the pads again from over the wicket, he tries to nudge it fine but misses and the ball trickles off his pads
Yuvraj stays at the crease, gives himself a bit of room and tries to slog it over long-on, he miscues it and Smith takes it just inches from the rope
slides on the pads, he sweeps hard to deep square leg to bring up his fifty
full on middle, he pushes it to long-on
makes contact with the slog sweep this time and he places it to deep midwicket
slides it really wide down the legside, it was so wide that Pomersbach couldn't get bat on it, it beats the keeper as well
swept to short fine leg
ditto! Fernando foxes him with another slower one, he tries to hoick him across the line but misses again, that's a super over
and again! Pomersbach is struggling to pick the slower balls, this time he cuts back on the pace even further and Pomersbach looks helpless as another swing across the line meets thin air
good stuff by Fernando as he bowls another slower one on seeing him advance down the track, he swings and misses
fullish outside off and he pushes it towards the covers
good comeback by Fernando as he fires in a slower ball outside the offstump, Yuvraj leans onto the stroke too early and he misses
He starts off with a full delivery on the pads, Yuvraj makes a bit of room and whips it wide of deep square leg, that's a good way to get off the mark
well bowled, he fires in a yorker on middle stump and he just manages to dig it out
flighted on middle and leg, he cuts back on the pace and Marsh is beaten a bit on the flight, he steps down to loft over long on but doesn't get the elevation going, Pollock takes it easily
tossed on the legs, he whips it wide of midwicket
this time the ball's a lot flatter, it lands in line of middle and leg and he slog sweeps it high over deep midwicket
tossed on offstump, pushed wide of point
full ball on the legs, he scoops it over midwicket and the fielder in the deep picks it up
steps down and clubs a low full toss back to the bowler
gives him the charge again and this time he lofts it through the line and carts it over mid-on, there's nobody there to cut it off
slides on the pads, this is getting too predictable here, he gets on his knee and sweeps this one hard and the ball races along the turf and beats deep square leg
risky running! He taps it towards mid-off and calls for the  run, Marsh is sent back and Yeligati runs forward to collect the ball, he takes aim and the ball strikes Marsh instead of the stumps
slides down the legside, he gets down to sweep but misses
fires that flat outside the legstump and for the umpteenth time today it's pushed to the deep on the on side
steps down the track and pushes a full delivery through the line to long-on
gives him the charge and pushes it on the full towards the bowler, Chitnis misfields off his own bowling, we've seen a few slips ups today in the field
slides on the pads, he sweeps to fine leg
gets forward and tucks it to short fine leg
full on the pads and he slog sweeps it against the turn to beat deep midwicket

a mis-hit goes for a six! What's with the bats these days?? Steps down the track to loft over midwicket but he ends up miscuing it high to long-on, Smith runs across to catch it but there's enough elevation to take it over the rope
gives it a bit too much air and he clubs a full toss to long-off
streaky but he's take it, he attempts a slog sweep but the ball is too full for that, he gets a thick inside edge which creeps between his legs and runs to fine leg
steps down the track and whips a low full toss behind square on the on side
lands the ball on off and middle this time, he chops it to the infield on the offside
slides on the pads, he steps down and pushes a low full toss across the line to Uthappa at deep midwicket
pitched outside off, he angles it to short third man
shot! Pitched up just outside the offstump, he reaches out, stays at the crease and lofts it across the line to clear long-on, excellent timing on that one
slightly wide outside off this time and he shoulders arms
loses his direction and sprays it wide outside off, he decides against chasing it
walks down the pitch and pushes a full delivery through the line to long-off
gets a bit of width this time and he opens the faced of the bat and angles it down to third man
bowls round the wicket, he makes a bit of room and chops it towards point
slides on the pads this time and he whips it on the up to Pollock at fine leg
bangs it in short, the slowness of the pitch allows him to swivel, get on top of the bounce and hook just over the deep fine leg rope, that was well controlled
full outside off, he pushes it to long-off
opens the face of the bat and angles it down to third man
slower ball, he places it towards mid-on
full outside off, he drives to the offside
misfield! Very sloppy stuff from Uthappa! He gets forward and drives it hard past the covers, Uthappa over runs it and makes a mess
mows this one across the line and places it just wide of mid-on
hits a good length outside off, he chops it down to deep point

missed opportunity! He steps down the track and scoops over extra cover, Pollock runs across and throws it to the bowler's end, the bail is dislodged before the batsman reaches the crease and the third umpire has a look, it looks like a direct hit but there's confusion as to how the bail was dislodged in the first place. Had Smith collected the ball and whipped off the bails he would have gone, after a long delay the umpire gives Pomersbach the benefit of the doubt
gives him just a bit of width and he shifts to the backfoot and angles it towards point
much shorter in length this time and he swivels and pulls it down to deep square leg, didn't quite time it as well as he would've liked
full again, slightly slower, he drives to mid-off
this time it's full on the offstump and he drives firmly to long-off
he overpitches outside the offstump, Marsh gets down on his knee early and executes a booming square drive past backward point
he errs by banging it in short, that's suicidal on this slow pitch as he swivels and pulls high over midwicket, the sweeper on the on side can't get to it
gets it to curve back in late, he gets into the stroke early and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads
slides on the pads this time, he gets down to sweep but makes contact with the pad only
pitches on middle and off, he chooses to defend this time, that's rare
misfield, he steps forward and whips it fine against the turn, Tendulkar at short fine leg makes a mess of it and lets the ball slip through
steps down and tucks it wide of midwicket
steps down and whips it wide of square leg, Nayar loses his shoe as he bends to pick it up
full outside off, he pushes it to mid-off

classic! The ball is flighted on legstump, he makes room, gives him the charge and lofts it with the turn over long-off, the best part was the way he angled the bat just before the point of contact to place it on the offside
gives it plenty of air outside leg and Marsh this time fails to whip it away wide of midwicket
flighted on middle and off, he steps down the track and just lofts over mid-off, not quite timed to perfection but very effective
bad ball, it's a full toss and he fails to capitalise on it as he places it straight to short fine leg
slides on the pads, he works it towards short fine leg
almost fires it on the blockhole and strikes him low on the pad as he shapes to loft over mid-on, Pinal Shah gets very excited
slightly short of a length and he pulls this behind square on the on side
excellent running! He tucks it softly towards midwicket and sets off quickly, two fielders converge but they're a bit lazy in getting to it and the batsmen seize the chance to take another run
slides on the pads, he works it to the gap on the on side

makes room and gives him the charge, he tries to loft over the bowler but gets a thick outside edge which balloons over short third man, not the best of strokes, Pollock shouldn't be too worried with that
opens the face of the bat and angles it wide of point
beaten! Pollock's really squaring up Marsh here, he steps down the track, checks his stroke as he sees the ball moving away just a touch after pitching, Pollock knew how close that was
it's short of a length and it sits up nicely on him as he swivels, gets on top of the bounce and pulls well clear of mid-on and midwicket
keeps it a bit short again and he mistimes his pull and the ball rolls to square leg
bang! Not that bad a delivery, it comes on straight off a good length and he takes a couple of paces down and clubs it straight over the bowler's head, the ball just lands over the rope
swing and a miss, the ball stops a bit after pitching and his swing across the line meets thin air, that wasn't too far from the stumps either
gives him a bit of width outside off and he deftly angles it down to third man
drives hard at a full delivery on the stumps and Nehra does well to intercept it with his left hand on the follow through
lovely delivery, the slower one, he taps it back to the bowler
bangs it in short again and angles it towards the body, he swivels and pulls to deep square leg

Dropped! How costly would that be? Marsh steps down the track to a short of a length delivery and suddenly checks his stroke, he slices it towards short point and Uthappa who appears to have it covered dives forward and spills the catch, he knows he should have taken that
hits a good length outside off  and he taps it towards cover
adjusts the line and brings it closer to the left hander this time, he defends and angles it square of the wicket
false stroke, he sees the ball angling across him and has a waft at it without moving his feet
can't beat mid-off again I'm afraid, this time he takes a couple of paces down the track and slams it straight to the fielder who's a bit deep
gets this one to nip back in only slightly, he gets behind the line and defends
fires this one faster outside the offstump, Marsh has to bend down quickly to drive square but he ends up mistiming it in front of cover
holds the length back only slightly and Marsh drives quite firmly, can't beat mid-off again
gets away with another half volley this time as he pushes it softly to mid-off
bowls the half volley on the pads and he swivels just a touch and whips it wide of midwicket, that was easy pickings
tries to break the shackles by dancing down the track but he mistimes the loft, the ball swirls in the air for a long time and Fernando isn't quick enough to run back from mid-off and take it
slants it across the left hander this time and Pomersbach wisely chooses to let it go
hits a good length on the offstump, makes him play straight away as he taps it softly towards point
pitches it on the corridor of uncertainty outside the offstump, Hopes has to play at it and he fails to account for the late movement after pitching, the thin edge is taken easily by Pinal Shah
gives him the same amount of width and he angles it just wide of point to get the innings off the mark
Shaun v Shaun.... Pollock has his say early on as he slants it across the left hander and Marsh lets it go

The six-match winning streak finally ends! And it's the captain Yuvraj Singh who sets a brilliant example! Yeligati drives but mistimes it towards mid-off, they for for the single anyway, Yeligati knows he's struggling and Yuvraj decides to make a dash for the stumps instead of attempting a direct hit, he flings himself at the stumps and knocks all three of them down with Yeligati well short of his ground. The third umpire is called for but Punjab know they've done it, Yuvraj is in a frenzy
makes room and chops it down towards the bowler, they go for the run and VRV makes an unnecessary attempt at the non strikers end, the throw is backed up at mid-on and they take a second run

the drama continues! He drives a full delivery through the covers, Srivastava makes a sliding save behind point, they attempt a third run and Nehra is just short of his ground as Kaul whips off the bails
makes room and misses, they steal a bye

And here's another twist! He creams this along the turf to deep extra cover, Srivastava picks it upo and hurls it back to the keeper as they attempt a second run, Kaul whips off the bails and Chitnis is short of hos ground
Dropped: The ball is full outside off, he scoops it high over extra cover, Srivastava is struggling to judge that and he spills the catch while falling backwards
off all times VRV has to bowl a waist high full toss! Chitnis makes room and scoops it high over third man
he dishes it out full and wide outside off, he makes room and slices it hard down to third man
this task is getting tougher and tougher for Mumbai! Sreesant gets away with a full toss outside off, Shah slogs across the line and VRV at deep midwicket runs backwards and pulls off a neat catch
he bowls the full delivery which swings in, he pullde over midwicket but can't find the ropes
steps down the track and plays a chipped shot just wide of Jayawardene at midwicket
slightly short of a length and he cuts it to third man
hits a good length outside off and he gets off the mark with a slice just wide of sweeper cover
There's further trouble for Mumbai as Uthappa steps down the track and tries to launch him downtown, he hits it down Hopes' throat at long-on
flighted on middle and leg, he sweeps to midwicket
he reverse sweeps to gully
glided to fine leg
moves across hi stumps and paddles it down to fine leg
Now this is getting really interesting! Yuvraj slides it down the legside, Pollock shapes to paddle it fine but he gets a thick leading edge which lobs to Chawla ar short third man

Do we have a game here? Uthappa rocks back and softly tucks it towards midwicket, they set off for the run but Tendulkar is sent back after Pathan runs forward and gathers the ball quickly, he takes aim and strikes the stumps down with Tendulkar yards outside his crease
plays a short arm pull across the line but can;t beat midwicket
shapes to hook a short delivery but he takes his eyes off the ball and the ball strikes him flush on the helmet, that unsettles him
steps down the track to disturb the bowler's rhythm, he punches it to mid-off
walks across his stumps and plays a deliberate paddle down to fine leg, Sreeasanth nearly lets it slip through
Pathan returns for a new spell, he bangs in a slow bouncer down the legside and Tendulkar swings and misses
slides on the pads, he whips it wide of square leg
full and wide outside off, he just caresses it wide of extra cover and the crowd go wild
slides on the pads, he turns it wide of midwicket and they set off for a couple
attempts a cheeky glide past the slips but gets beaten, Kaul thinks he edged it and he goes up in appeal, Bowden shakes his head
streaky, but he'll take it! He leans forward and drives hard at a half volley wide outside the offstump, the edge beats the keeper and Tendulkar's bat slips out of his gloves on the drive
full and wide outside the offstump, he drives to the fielder at deep cover
brilliant improvisation by Tendulkar! Yuvraj fires it in short and quick, Tendulkar stays at the crease and plays an upper cut which beats short third man
slides on the pads, he whips it to midwicket
stays at the crease and plays a deliberate paddle shot down to fine leg
waits for it at the crease and taps it towards point
he charges down the track and just checks his stroke, the ball lobs to the vacant areas near square leg
flighted on middle and leg, he works it wide of midwicket

nearly a stumping! Uthappa gets beaten on the drive and he's out of the crease as the ball beats him, Kaul whips off the bails and the third umpire takes a look, Uthappa just manages to drag his bat back to the crease
angles it on his pads, Uthappa waits for it and glances it past the keeper and down to fine leg
rocks back at the crease and punches a short of a length delivery down to sweeper cover
pitches it short of a length and gets it to skid through, he rocks back and pulls to fine leg
shoulders arms to one that straightens after pitching

huge relief for Punjab! Chawla flights it on middle and leg, Nayar gets on his knee for the slogsweep and he nearly succeeds in clearing the rope, Srivastava just manages to hang onto it before the rope at deep square leg
he dishes out a half volley on the pads and Tendulkar effortlessly flicks it wide of the diving mid-on fielder, that's 19 off the over
full on middle and leg, he whips it to the on side
and the crowd are loving it! VRV digs it in a fraction short down the legside, Nayar heaves it over fine leg and that lands a few rows back again
shot! He pitches it up on middle and leg, he gets on top of the bounce and lofts through the line over long-on, that went a few rows back
he makes room and squeezes out a yorker to mid-on for a single
jams that on the blockhole and Nayar manages to squeeze it out to short fine leg
that's vintage Tendulkar! He distracts the bowler by walking across his stumps early and playing a deliberate paddle scoop past short fine leg
full on the pads, he tucks it to the on side
reaches out to a full delivery outside off and gets a thick outside edge to third man
takes a couple of paces down the track and softly places it towards cover
fires in an inswinging yorker, Nayar nearly falls over on the stroke and Pathan bellows an appeal, that was missing leg anyway
lands the slow offcutter outside off, he waits on it and slices it wide of point
fullish on the pads, he tucks it softly in front of mid-on for a single
full outside off, he places it to Pomersback at deep point
there's further insult for VRV as Tendulkar puts away a half volley outside off and beats the sweeper cover fielder by a large margin
Dropped! Nayar seizes a short delivery and pulls over midwicket, he fails to time it properly and Pomersbach spills a sitter, he juggles and still makes a mess of it
jams in a slow yorker outside the offstump, he works his wrists just a little and takes a quick single to mid-on
angles this on he pads and the ball lands on a full length, he plays a wristy flick down to deep square leg
slides on the pads, he works it down to fine leg
he feeds him with width outside the offstump, Nayar goes back and across and punches it past the covers, the placement was good the power in that stroke was enough to beat sweeper cover
grants him a bit of width outside the offstump, he reaches out and dabs it down to third man
slightly short of a length, he swivels and pulls behind square on the offside
leans forward and drives a full delivery on the up down towards backward point
tries to dab this down to third man but is beaten
steps down the track and creams a full delivery towards the covers but Marsh is there again to save it, they take a single after the ball lobs off his palm
nayar fails to put away a low full toss, he places it to Marsh at short cover
makes room and chops it towards short third man

he punches it softly towards Yuvraj at mid-off and Smith is already off the blocks for a risky single, Tendulkar sends him back and Smith is struggling to make his ground, Yuvraj lobs the ball back to Chawla who knocks the bails down with his arm but importantly has the ball in hand, the third umpire has a look and Smith is just short of his ground
drives away from his body and the bottom edge nearly trickles onto the stumps
pitches on leg and strikes the pads just outside the line of legstump, Kaul appeals
beats him this time, Hopes gets the ball to nip back in just a little and that squares up Smith who attempts a glide to third man I guess
gets a half stride forward and punches it square of the wicket on the offside, the sweeper cuts it off
fullish outside off, he drives to sweeper cover
walks across his stumps for a premeditated paddle scoop but the ball lobs off his pads and lands well clear of any fielder on the on side
hits a good length outside off and he punches to the offside
When you bowl to Tendulkar on the pads you're asking for trouble, Tendulkar shuffles and just manages to chip it over short midwicket, VRV gives up the chase at the boundary
leans onto the drive a little early and he only pushes it back to the bowler
pitches on a good length on middle, he shuffles and pulls on the front foot to deep square leg
good length, dabbed to short third man
No slip in place and that hurts Chawla, Tendulkar slashes very close to the body and the outside edge beats short third man as well
leans onto the drive a little too early and as a result he gets an inside edge onto his pads
full outside off, he drives it to long-off
short and wide outside off and asking to be hit, Sachin leans backwards and upper cut it down to third man
knocks the stumps down on the delivery stride, he tucks it to the on side
he errs by drifting towards the body, Tendulkar waits for it and glances it late well past the keeper and fine leg
tries to steer this one past the packed offside field but Marsh's sliding save at point limits it to a dot ball
excellent comeback by VRV as he slices him in half with a delivery which kicks up off a good length, not far from the edge though
lands a half volley on the pads, that's easy meat for Tendulkar as he shuffles and tucks it wide of midwicket with a flick of the wrists
good finish to the over, Smith gets across and defends it solidly back to the bowler
slower ball, it lands on a good length and he tucks it behind square on the on side
Sreesanth overcompensates by bowling too full on the pads, he whips it away wide of midwicket and the outfield does the rest
bangs it in short, Smith gets on top of the bounce quickly and bludgeons it over deep square leg
Sreesanth attempts one slower ball too many and lands it too short, that gives Smith enough time to rock back at his crease and chop it down hard to beat backward point and cover
full and swinging away, he leans forward and steers it down to cover
finishes the over with a slower ball, he waits on it and angles it softly in front of cover
gets this to swing in big time on the pads, he shapes to whip it across the line but the ball trickles off his pads
hits a good length outside off, he gets across and taps it back to the bowler
follows it up with a slow offcutter, Smith is beaten
leans forward to smack it past the covers but mistimes the stroke, he gets an inside edge which trickles to the on side
hits a good length outside off, he stays back, covers the line and punches past the bowler
ends the over with a slower ball, Smith leans forward and drives to mid-off
hits a good length outside off, he punches it to point

terrific variation! Sreesanth mixes it up by bowling the slow legbreak, Jayasuriya walks across to stumps to mow it behind square on the on side but plays too early, he's struck on the thigh in front of offstump, the umpire Pratapkumar is convinced
good line and length, bangs it on middle and the ball holds its line, Jayasuriya shows him some respect by defending back to the bowler
the ball rises off a good length and he punches it just a fraction wide of extra cover
shuffles across his stumps a little too early and tucks it to the on side off his pads
Temdulkar joins the party this time, he latches on to a half volley outside off and places it perfectly in the arc between mid-off and cover
shuffles across his stumps a little too early and he only manages to tuck it softly in front of Pathan
take that! Pathan shapes this one on middle and off and Jayasuriya picks the length early again, shuffles and whips it over long-on, imperious stroke that
he misdirects the outswinger and lands it too full and wide outside off, jayasuriya reaches out, flashes hard and gets a thick outside edge to third man fence
now Pathan struggles with extras as he slides this wide down the legside, Kaul fails to gather it properly and the ball lobs off his glove and rolls away
gets prodigious away swing, Jayasuriya picks a low full toss and taps it towards mid-off
that was full and swinging away from the left hander, Jayasuriya moved across his stumps early, picks the length and scoops it over long-on
full and angling across the right hander, he drives on the up and Marsh shows very good commitment to fling himself to his right and intercept it with one hand
hits a good length and gets it to rise on Tendulkar and nip back in sharply, the ball strikes him on the hips as he tries to flick it away
pitches on a good length outside off, he hops at the crease and taps it wide of point
gets just a bit of late inward movement, he tries to whip it away wide of mid-on but mistimes it
slides on his pads and whips it away wide of midwicket, VRV does the chasing, this is a never ending over
beats him, this time he bowls it slightly wide outside off and Jayasuriya flashes at it without moving his feet, that's the first legitimate ball of the innings
wide again! Not as wide as the previous two though, Jayasuriya shuffles and attempts to pull but misses
it gets worse! Sreesanth struggles to control the movement and sprays it so wide down the legside that Kaul has no chance of stopping it
very inauspicious start for Sreesanth as he sprays wide down the legside, Kaul does well to stop it
